event: A quick look at the write_user_lock test.

I submitted the verdict as verified for four of the five items. The fifth, `cr_071a71b48260` (ownership precedence order), is inconclusive.

I found no test that fills the named gaps, but the search was thin. I read only one extra test in detail, `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_write_user_lock`. It has Root set `TARGET_USER_VALID=1` and checks the SRAM owner becomes Target. It never writes `TARGET_USER` or `TARGET_USER_VALID` again after the grant or after a terminal `TARGET_STATUS`.

I did not open the other test directories. For the four verified items, the statements about the other tests rest on the finding's own description. I did not look at the ownership-flow tests or the RTL precedence logic, which is why `cr_071a71b48260` stays inconclusive.
